description: This file is a PHP test class for the ProviderAPI component in the OpenID Authentication plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting provider entities via API endpoints, utilizing mock services and test data providers.

classes.name: ProviderAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase to perform API testing on the ProviderAPI component, focusing on CRUD operations with mock setup.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the API's create provider endpoint using data from the data provider.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single provider via the API.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all providers via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a provider via the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a provider via the API.
